newsitem.title: USA: Hewlett, Cox in cable modem deal.
newsitem.headline: Hewlett, Cox in cable modem deal.

text.p: Hewlett-Packard Co said on Wednesday Cox Communications Inc will test HP's QuickBurst Link cable modem and router beginning in early 1997.

Financial terms of the deal were undisclosed, but Hewlett-Packard said Cox, a provider of cable television, plans to roll-out high-speed Internet access in its largest cable markets during 1997 and 1998.
In a statement, Cox said it is currently looking at several cable modems to build what it called "the best delivery system for high-speed data" to its subscribers.
"We believe these deals are a step toward volume deployments," Bill Hahn, manager of interactive broadband products operation at Hewlett-Packard, said in a statement.
The QuickBurst Link allows personal computer users to access on-line services at speeds hundreds of times faster than traditional telephone modems, the company said.
